query: What do I know about implementing a new retrieval pipeline with RRF fusion?
memory_content_preview: Implemented WRRF (Weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion) pipeline combining vector search, FTS, and graph priors with configurable weights.

query: Remind me what was decided about the embedding model choice.
memory_content_preview: Decision: Use all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-d) as the default embedding model. Fast CPU inference, good enough for the hook latency budget.

query: What did I note regarding SurrealDB schema migrations?
memory_content_preview: Schema migration pattern: each migration_NNN function is idempotent and registered in the CAPABILITY_REGISTRY. Migrations run in order on startup.

query: Recall anything related to the write gate threshold tuning.
memory_content_preview: WRITE_GATE_THRESHOLD=0.0 stores everything. Shadow mode (WRITE_GATE_SHADOW_THRESHOLD=0.15) stamps would_reject without actually dropping memories.

query: What have I learned about cross-encoder reranking performance?
memory_content_preview: GTE-reranker-modernbert achieves strong reranking quality with acceptable CPU latency. NLI reranking averages 55s/call — too slow for production.

query: What was the outcome about the consolidation cycle timing?
memory_content_preview: Consolidation cooldown set to 1800s to prevent back-to-back cycles. Idle threshold 300s triggers consolidation when no activity detected.

query: Find my notes on the Prometheus metrics architecture.
memory_content_preview: Prometheus metrics use an isolated CollectorRegistry to prevent cross-contamination in tests. I23 invariant: every declared metric must have a writer.

query: What do I remember about the LongMemEval benchmark results?
memory_content_preview: LongMemEval at v5.26.0: MRR 0.928, Recall@10 0.906, nDCG@10 0.863, QA 69.4%. Retrieval-only phase uses session-level scoring.

query: Tell me what was recorded about the OTel tracing setup.
memory_content_preview: OTLP exporter configured with short 3s timeout so dead collector fails fast. OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true in test environments to avoid tracing overhead.

query: What context exists for the file queue drain mechanism?
memory_content_preview: File queue drains every 30s (QUEUE_DRAIN_INTERVAL). DLQ retains entries 90 days. Permanent failures after 3 attempts, transient after 20.

query: What memories are tagged architecture?
memory_content_preview: Architecture decision: MCP server wraps yadgar core. FastMCP handles JSON-RPC routing. Tools registered via @_tool decorator pattern.

query: Find everything tagged decision.
memory_content_preview: Decision: use Forgejo (self-hosted Gitea) for source control instead of GitHub for privacy and control.

query: What do I have stored under the tag debugging?
memory_content_preview: Debugging: FTS query preprocessing removes special chars that trigger SurrealDB syntax errors. Apostrophes especially problematic.

query: Recall my testing notes.
memory_content_preview: Testing pattern: pytest-split divides the suite into 5 chunks for parallel CI. Pre-push hook runs e2e suite with surreal binary.

query: What's in my performance category?
memory_content_preview: Performance: hook recall budget is 2s (HOOK_RECALL_TIMEOUT_S). Fast profile uses smaller candidate multiplier (3) to bound latency.

query: What's the latest I recorded on the dream/sleep consolidation feature?
memory_content_preview: Dream cycle (v5.72): co_occurrence links + dream insights + reembed_stale + auto_narrate all proven working in nightly consolidation.

query: What was the most recent thing I noted about engram temporal clustering?
memory_content_preview: Engram uses competitive temporal clustering (Josselyn-Frankland model). Excitability decays with 6h half-life. Stability increments on retrieval.

query: What did I last note about the COMET enrichment issue?
memory_content_preview: BC-EN2a: COMET enrichment fails FPA filter (threshold 0.25). COMET traits are semantically distant from literal content — all filtered out.

query: What do I know about the wiki similarity gate calibration?
memory_content_preview: Wiki sim gate calibrated at 0.80 cosine threshold. Near-dup pairs score 0.95+, distinct pairs 0.44-0.71. Gap of 0.24 gives clean separation.

query: Remind me what was decided about the astrocyte domain consolidation.
memory_content_preview: Astrocyte domain consolidation uses keyword/regex matching to assign domains. ASTROCYTE_POOL_ENABLED=True by default (4 processes).

query: What did I note regarding the Hopfield energy implementation?
memory_content_preview: Hopfield network capped at 5000 patterns. Beta=8.0 (high sharpness). Wired but off in production — never called in hot recall path.

query: Recall anything related to the cold memory retention policy.
memory_content_preview: Cold memory purge: COLD_MEMORY_PURGE_ENABLED=False (report only). Purge requires two gates: ENABLED=True AND DRY_RUN=False. Safety-first.

query: What have I learned about the surprise score computation?
memory_content_preview: Surprise score from predictive coding module. WRITE_GATE_SHADOW_THRESHOLD=0.15 stamps would_reject=True without actual rejection.

query: What was the outcome about the config three-way sync invariant?
memory_content_preview: I25: every Settings field must appear in config.py, config_yaml.py, and config_registry.py. test_config_three_way_sync.py enforces this.

query: Find my notes on the CLS dual-store architecture.
memory_content_preview: CLS (complementary learning systems) dual-store: episodic memories consolidate to semantic via greedy clustering at sim >= 0.7 nightly.

query: What do I remember about the successor representation retrieval?
memory_content_preview: sr_retrieve: successor-representation associative retrieval. Implemented but untested in production. SR discount=0.9, update rate=0.1.

query: Tell me what was recorded about the query expansion mechanism.
memory_content_preview: Query expansion (pseudo-HyDE): QUERY_EXPANSION_ENABLED=True. Generates hypothetical document then embeds for retrieval.

query: What context exists for the multi-passage evidence aggregation?
memory_content_preview: Multi-passage reranking clusters overlapping passages (overlap threshold 0.3, max cluster size 3) for evidence aggregation.

query: What memories are tagged infra?
memory_content_preview: Infrastructure: GitHub Actions replaced by Forgejo act_runner. CI uses 5-way pytest-split. Container: yadgar-ci:5.72.0.

query: Find everything tagged ml.
memory_content_preview: ML models: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (embedding), GTE-reranker-modernbert (reranking), doc2query/msmarco-t5-small (query gen).

query: What's the latest I recorded on the backup retention policy?
memory_content_preview: Backup retention: BACKUP_RETENTION=3 (keep last 3 backups). Older backups pruned automatically by the backup cleanup script.

query: What was the most recent thing I noted about the Forgejo CI workflow structure?
memory_content_preview: CI: test job splits into 5 matrix chunks. test-gate aggregates. invariant-checks job runs I23/I24/I25/I29/I32 sequentially.

query: What did I last note about reconsolidation?
memory_content_preview: Reconsolidation: below LOW_THRESHOLD (0.3) no modification. Above HIGH_THRESHOLD (0.7) archives old + creates new. Plasticity spikes on access.

query: What do I know about the causal discovery algorithm?
memory_content_preview: PC algorithm for causal discovery. Threshold: CAUSAL_THRESHOLD=3 co-occurrences before inferring a causal edge.

query: Remind me what was decided about the dead-letter queue taxonomy.
memory_content_preview: DLQ taxonomy: permanent failures (4xx) after 3 tries, transient (5xx/network) after 20. Retention 90 days. dlq_inspect/requeue/dismiss tools.

query: What did I note regarding the v6 quality measurement plan?
memory_content_preview: v6 Phase 0: eval harness gates all v6 quality work. Target: recall@k/MRR/nDCG committed baseline + make eval running in CI.

query: Recall anything related to the pre-commit hook configuration.
memory_content_preview: pre-commit hooks: check-capability-coverage, check-metric-writers, ruff format/check, and terraform hooks (backend-off only exempt).

query: What have I learned about the embedding cache eviction?
memory_content_preview: Embedding cache: EMBEDDING_CACHE_SIZE=128 entries LRU. MODEL_IDLE_EVICTION_SECONDS=0 (no eviction). Cache hits tracked per Prometheus counter.

query: What was the outcome about the narrative auto-generation?
memory_content_preview: auto_narrate: generates project story from memories. Runs nightly in consolidation cycle. Currently template-based; v6 Phase 4 targets LLM synthesis.

query: Find my notes on the CRDT conflict resolution.
memory_content_preview: CRDT: vector clock per memory (JSON). CRDT_AGENT_ID=default. Multi-agent conflict resolution uses LWW (last-write-wins) on merge.
